releases.image_description: A square, richly coloured digital illustration of a woman's face, painted as a Mexican Day of the Dead sugar skull. Her skin is cream, with ornate swirls, dots and teardrop shapes in red, orange and turquoise across her forehead and cheeks. Wide dark teal rings circle her pale blue eyes, the tip of her nose is painted dark teal, and thin black lines stitched across her red lips suggest skull teeth. Long, dark, wavy hair flows around her face, decorated with big red and orange roses, marigold-like flowers, teal leaves and small red berries. In the top left corner, in large white capital letters, are the words MARY JANE.

releases.image_description: A square, richly coloured digital illustration of a bald man staring straight ahead with a serious expression, his face painted as a Mexican Day of the Dead sugar skull. His forehead has a symmetrical pattern of swirls and a heart shape in red, teal and black on a cream base. Dark teal rings surround his pale blue eyes, the tip of his nose is painted dark teal, and black stitch lines run across his mouth and chin like skull teeth. More teal and red swirls run down his neck. He is completely surrounded by deep red roses, dark teal leaves and clusters of small red berries on a black background. Above his head, in large, bright red capital letters, is the word ALIEN.
